name: webong/composer-source-plugin
description: Select one Composer package source and generate optional namespace compatibility aliases.

suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: Register the compiler pass that exposes compatibility names as Symfony service aliases.
suggest.wikimedia/composer-merge-plugin: Merge a local package manifest before the source selector chooses the winning implementation.

scripts.test:integration:mirror: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/plugin:ro" -e COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 -e COMPOSER_HOME=/tmp/composer composer:2 bash /plugin/tests/integration/mirror.sh
scripts.test:integration:projection: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/plugin:ro" -e COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 -e COMPOSER_HOME=/tmp/composer composer:2 bash /plugin/tests/integration/projection.sh
scripts.test:integration:workspaces: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/plugin:ro" -e COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1 -e COMPOSER_HOME=/tmp/composer composer:2 bash /plugin/tests/integration/workspaces.sh
